question.question_text: During the cooking activity, which item was used more frequently: the knife or the cooking stick?

answer_options.text: Both were used with the same frequency
The cooking activity did not involve the use of a cooking stick
Cooking stick was used more frequently
The cooking activity did not involve the use of a knife
